notes: Head of *A young man* is the one arguable choice. Rule 31's tie-break is satisfied here: the ASV writes a bare *the man* for אִישׁ in this same passage (v.19), so *man* is read as the class noun realizing the lexeme and *young* as its specifier; heading on *young*, as *dry land* heads on *dry*, was the competing reading and is named in the unit.
*simple ones* and *of understanding* follow rules 31 and 19; both assimilated articles take their written *the* (rule 12).
